title: weight claim is wrong
text: weight claim is wrong. I got this storage ottoman after weeks of waiting and it turns out that the 500lbs is incorrect. They have a weight capacity rating at the bottom of the listing showing dimensions and weight and it shows 500, but when I read instructions on the packaging itself, it says good for up to 300lbs. I was hoping I can use this as a back-up option for 2 people to sit down if needed, but that would only work for 2 kids/teens and not for 2 regular sized adults. That was disappointing, but the ottoman otherwise looks nice and the fabric and color is pretty. I'm debating if I want to return it or not. Sigh

product_metadata.title: Ornavo Home Foldable Tufted Linen Large Storage Ottoman Bench Foot Rest Stool/Seat - 15" x 30" x 15" (Grey)
features: DURABILITY: The luxurious feel of the linen upholstery is comfortable and inviting, and its durable construction ensures the ottoman's place in your home for a long time.

STORAGE SPACE: Store exercise equipment, household accessories or extra linens inside this spacious ottoman, and use the top as a foot rest or extra seating when you're relaxing with friends in the living room.

DESIGN: The tufted ottoman is the perfect addition to any room that is in need of an ottoman that can double as a comfortable seat. This ottoman is both soft and stylish, giving you the best of both worlds, allowing you to relax knowing that your guests are comfortable.

COMFORTABILITY: Thick cushioning creates a plush place to sit or to rest your feet, while the sturdy base offers added stability. The linen upholstery lends classic beauty while standing up to regular use in your home.
FOLDABLE: It’s lightweight folding design allows you to store this ottoman away when not in use. The comfortable padded lid come off allowing you to fold the ottoman flat and store in any space.
